change: Follow docs/v3/EXPRESSION.md § The loop for cases n08, n11, n15, n19, n20 and n21 (all native; none has run). Every referenced case in the bank has run. Before pinning, check TuffUI (github.com/yurigdesigner/tuffui) for visualization components published after `589cbb0` (2026-11-13; cycles 4 and 5 found none); for each one, add a `c` case, its reference row and shot, and run it in place of a native case. With fewer than four referenced cases the cycle file reports the convergence clause on the referenced cases it has and says the clause cannot be met in full; with none, the verdict counts are empty. You are the lead: you spawn, shoot, collect and diagnose; you build nothing and score nothing. (1) Builders: one fresh subagent per case on the default worker tier, with the case row verbatim, the scenario id `expr-<case id>`, and the fence of cycle 5 (its builder prompt, `.evidence/v3-shots/expression-5/builder-prompt.md` in the main checkout, is the model; its `check-theme` gate line is gone, the verb was retired in 4d2d7302). Pre-register the registry and scenario-info entries with placeholders so each builder owns one directory, run oxfmt on scenario-info.ts after adding them, and tell builders that `fixture` reaches the scenario as a prop. Each builder builds into its own dist directory and shoots its own route. (2) Shoot each scenario with apps/playground/scripts/shots.ts, plus the keyboard frame, the list frame and the pointer sweep of cycle 5's lead tool (`.evidence/v3-shots/expression-5/lead-shots.ts`: the key the host's role takes, the focused element after each press, a list frame that rescans its rows at hover time, an evidence frame where no list links). (3) Reviewers: one fresh subagent per case and round, never the builder, with the case row, the shot paths, a snapshot of the scenario source for that round, docs/v3/expression/rubric.md and the shoot log. Tell it to open every shot. (4) Repair: hand the builder its reviewer's findings, at most two more rounds, shooting and scoring after each. (5) Diagnose every point lost in round 0 into one class from EXPRESSION.md § Finding classes, using the builder's wish list and its workaround comments as evidence. Where an open plan row already owns a gap, class the finding `planned` and append it as a `notes` entry to that row's brief instead of filing a row. (6) Judge the three hypotheses against EXPRESSION.md § Thresholds, using this cycle's numbers and the verdict lines of docs/v3/spikes/viz-census.md. (7) File per CYCLES.md step 6. A fix that adds a public export, changes charts/contract.ts or changes what primitive-bypass denies is one row with `checkpoint: spec` and seat opus high. Add new cases to the bank from sources not used yet, as note (f) says. Report factory friction with `factory signal file`, not as a row. Lead notes from cycle 5: (a) check before round 0 that v3-expr-5-keys landed: `basalt-ui shot` writes a keyboard frame and the app lint preset fails a closure that reads a later const; if it did, say whether builders used the frame unasked (cycle 5: 0 of 6 opened one, cycle 4: 2 of 6 wrote their own); (b) check v3-expr-5-kit-fixes (1) and (2): a placed label clears a zone label and the bars of a band axis at 390, and a focus on a line chart dims the rest; if either did not land, tell builders so the same gap does not cost twice; (c) run `make check-fast` before scoring round 0, and stop it by pid before builders start round 1 if it is still queued for a slot; check-contract-frozen compares against `origin/master`, so a master that moved past the pin during the run reports pin changes this tree did not make: name it, do not chase it; (d) tell reviewers that a `{ light, dark }` pair in the app's series file and a `fillOpacity` number per mark are the shipped rules' sanctioned forms, not colour literals, and that K6 loses a point only to a defect a shot or a source line shows (cycle 5 lost 4 points to these readings: expression-5.7, .49, .61, .74); (e) a page whose PageBar shows only a title still starts its content 61 px down (`page.tsx:146`); tell reviewers it is the kit's and builders to leave it; (f) once this cycle runs, the bank's only never-run cases are the ones it adds: add six from pages no case covers yet, so cycle 7 can draw six, and say so (two a cycle is EXPRESSION.md's floor, not its ceiling; cycle 5 added three for the same reason); (g) report every score on all items and, for the trend against cycles 1 and 2, on the F and K items alone, as cycles 3 to 5 do.
